aaa_enabled.summary: Configure external RADIUS/LDAP authentication for centralized admin access control.
aaa_enabled.notes: SonicOS supports RADIUS, LDAP, and local authentication. Configure at least one external authentication server. Ref: SonicWall KB - Admin Best Practices (kA1VN0000000Jyv0AE).

secure_vty_transport.summary: SonicOS does not support telnet management. Disable HTTP management and restrict to HTTPS and SSH only.
secure_vty_transport.notes: SonicOS does not have telnet; only HTTPS, HTTP, SSH, SNMP, and Ping are management protocols. Disable HTTP to ensure encrypted-only management. Ref: SonicOS/X 7 CLI Reference Guide.

vty_idle_timeout.summary: Set administrator idle timeout to 10 minutes or less.
vty_idle_timeout.notes: Range is 1-9999 minutes. SonicWall hardening guide recommends 10 minutes. Default is 5 minutes. Ref: SonicWall KB - Admin Idle Timeout CLI (kA1VN0000000FOx0AM).

enable_secret_encrypted.summary: SonicOS stores admin passwords hashed by default. Ensure password complexity is enabled.
enable_secret_encrypted.notes: SonicOS does not have a separate enable secret; all admin passwords are stored hashed. Enable password complexity for strong credentials. Ref: SonicWall KB - Password Constraints (kA1VN0000000FvC0AU).

no_default_snmp_community.summary: Change the default SNMP community name from 'public' or disable SNMP entirely.
no_default_snmp_community.notes: If SNMP is required, use SNMPv3 with Mandatory Require SNMPv3 enabled. Default community is 'public'. Ref: SonicWall KB - SNMP Configuration (170505617080053).

no_write_snmp_community.summary: SonicWall SNMP community strings are read-only by default. Disable SNMP if not needed.
no_write_snmp_community.notes: SonicOS SNMP communities are read-only. If SNMP is required, use SNMPv3 with authentication and privacy. Ref: SonicWall KB - SNMP Configuration (170505617080053).

http_server_disabled.summary: Disable HTTP management access globally and per interface.
http_server_disabled.notes: HTTP transmits management credentials in cleartext. Disable on all interfaces and globally. Ref: SonicWall KB - Web Management CLI (170504284559119).

ssh_version_2.summary: SonicOS SSH is always protocol version 2. No action required.
cli: # SonicOS SSH is natively version 2; no action required.
ssh_version_2.notes: SonicOS only supports SSH protocol version 2. Ref: SonicOS/X 7 CLI Reference Guide.

management_acl.summary: Restrict management services on WAN interface and limit to management VLAN.
management_acl.notes: Disable all management protocols on WAN-facing interfaces. Management should be restricted to trusted LAN/management interfaces only. Ref: SonicWall KB - High Security Setup (kA1VN0000000IRi0AM).

logging_enabled.summary: Configure remote syslog servers and enable enhanced audit logging.
logging_enabled.notes: Configure at least one remote syslog server. Enable enhanced audit logging for configuration change tracking. Ref: SonicWall KB - Enhanced Audit Logging (170505386294195).

ntp_configured.summary: Configure at least one NTP server for time synchronization.
ntp_configured.notes: At least two NTP servers should be configured for redundancy. Accurate time is essential for log correlation. Ref: SonicWall KB - NTP/SNMP Services (kA1VN0000000J2f0AE).

login_banner.summary: Configure a pre-login policy banner with an authorized-use notice.
cli: # Pre-login banner is configured via Web UI:
# SonicOS 7: Device | Users | Settings > Customization > Pre-Login Policy Banner
# Enable 'Start With Policy Banner Before Login Window'
login_banner.notes: SonicOS pre-login banner is primarily configured via the web UI. CLI access to banner text is limited. Ref: SonicWall KB - Login Banner (kA1VN0000000Ogg0AE).

password_min_length.summary: Set minimum password length to at least 16 characters for high-security environments.
password_min_length.notes: SonicOS default minimum is 8 characters. SonicWall hardening guide recommends 16. Range is 1-99. Ref: SonicWall KB - High Security Setup (kA1VN0000000IRi0AM).

lockout_configured.summary: Enable login attempt lockout with appropriate thresholds.
lockout_configured.notes: SonicWall hardening guide recommends 3 failed attempts per minute with 30-minute lockout. Default is disabled. Ref: SonicWall KB - High Security Setup (kA1VN0000000IRi0AM).
